title: Lena and the Well
author: Ulyana Kavanagh
blurb: Jonah Whitlock, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
